heroHeadline: AMLO Legacy Deepens Under Scrutiny: Sitting Morena Governor Indicted for Cartel Ties
heroSubtitle: The 4T's cartel-accommodation debate escalates as U.S. prosecutors indict sitting Sinaloa Governor Rubén Rocha Moya alongside Morena senator Enrique Inzunza Cázarez (Apr 29–30, 2026); Rocha Moya took leave and, in a July 9 statement, rejected the charges as a 'media onslaught' while a co-defendant's June 1 New York hearing saw a judge call the evidence 'abundant.' Meanwhile the Tren Maya freight network — AMLO's flagship megaproject legacy — passed 54% completion (Jun 25).
footerNote: Data sourced from INEGI, CONEVAL, SESNSP, Banco de México, Diario Oficial, Animal Político, Reforma, Reuters, CNN, CBS News, Mexico News Daily, Bloomberg, and CSIS
